review: The 222-byte map at 0x540764..0x540842 matches original bytes. It retains signed comparisons over wrapped values, including R11+1 and R10-1, and the branch-selected updates to SP+64/SP+72 and R10. Child calls, literal 0x5409D8, fresh loads, wrapped transform values, and VCVT.F32.S32 ordering match the disassembly; FP controls remain architectural.
limitations: The larger candidate still includes opaque children and no independent proof that the raw discovery bounds equal the complete function boundary.
Architectural FP behavior, faults, aliases, concurrency, physical rendering, and external effects are not qualified.
Partial/unaccepted; no C, admission, or gates.
